correctness.rationale: Alternating cyclic bracket satisfies Jacobi in characteristic 2 since the distinct-basis Jacobiator contains only brackets [e_i,e_i]=0, and is perfect since each e_i is a bracket. A general symmetric bilinear map has 18 coefficients, and the derivation identity yields 27 homogeneous coefficient constraints of rank 11 over F2, nullity 7; direct independent bitset row reduction and seven parameter basis substitutions confirm rank and all identities. Same rational/prime-field rank and formulas apply over every char2 field; no classification for other Lie algebras.

value.rationale: The characteristic-2 algebra is dimension-minimal among nonzero perfect Lie algebras; its nonzero symmetric-biderivation space is a motivated sharp boundary obstruction to vanishing theorems in characteristic zero. Explicit universal-field classification is a natural structural invariant, not only a random sparse linear system.

final_claim: The minimal three-dimensional perfect Lie algebra with symmetric cyclic bracket in characteristic 2 has exactly seven-dimensional symmetric adjoint-biderivation space with an explicit seven-parameter basis.
limitations: A small characteristic-2 Lie algebra may have a prior tabulation of biderivations under an isomorphic basis or outer-derivation nomenclature.
